questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

In the __absence of government rule__, riots have broken out all over the country and everything is in a state of complete chaos.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Anarchy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Anarchy"** refers to a state of disorder due to the absence or non-recognition of authority or other controlling systems. (अराजकता)
 
• **​"Anarchy"** describes a situation where there is no government, and lawlessness prevails. (अराजकता)
 
 
• **Example:** With no leadership in place, the region quickly fell into **anarchy**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Anarchy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Oligarchy** (कुलीनतंत्र): A small group of people having control of a country, organization, or institution.

 
 
• **Example:** The nation was ruled by an **oligarchy **of wealthy elites.
 
 
 
• **Dictatorship** (तानाशाही): A country governed by a dictator.
 
 
• **Example:** Under the dictator's rule, the country experienced severe oppression.
 
 
 
• **Monarchy** (राजशाही): A form of government with a monarch at the head.
 
 
• **Example:** The country is a constitutional **monarchy**, where the king has limited powers.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

Looking up, she realised she had swum ________ than she'd thought.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**farther**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**farther**" is used to refer to physical distance. (दूर)
 
• In this context, "farther" correctly indicates a greater physical distance swum, which fits the sentence better than the other options.
 
• The other options: "**further**," "**furthest**," and "**farthest**" do not fit as well in this context. "Further" can refer to a greater extent in more abstract contexts, while "furthest" and "farthest" imply the greatest distance, which is not appropriate here.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Looking up, she realised she had swum farther__ than she'd thought.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Further (और अधिक)**: refers more to abstract concepts such as progress or degree, rather than physical distance.
 
• **Furthest (सबसे दूर)**: implies the greatest extent of something, but here, we are looking for a comparative degree of distance.
 
• **Farthest (दूरतम)**: is a superlative form, which also refers to the greatest distance, not a comparison of distance.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: A myriad of possibilities unfolds when the artist embarks on the journey of creative experimentation.
A myriad of possibilities unfolds when an artist embarks on a journey of creative experimentation.
The myriad of possibilities unfolds when the artist embarks on a journey of creative experimentation.
The myriad of possibilities unfolds when an artist embarks on the journey of creative experimentation.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**To answer this question, let's break down each sentence to identify the grammatically and contextually correct ones:**

__
 
• **A. A myriad of possibilities unfolds when the artist embarks on the journey of creative experimentation.**

 
 
• This sentence is grammatically correct, but it uses "the artist," which specifies a particular individual, making it slightly less general.
 
• This sentence is grammatically incorrect.__
 
 
 
• __​__**B. A myriad of possibilities unfolds when an artist embarks on a journey of creative experimentation.**
 __
 
• This sentence is grammatically correct and uses "an artist," which makes the statement more general and applicable to any artist.
 
• This sentence is grammatically and contextually correct__ because it implies the universal potential for creativity and experimentation by any artist.
 
 
 
• **C. The myriad of possibilities unfolds when the artist embarks on a journey of creative experimentation.**
 __
 
• This sentence uses "the myriad of," which is less commonly used, as "myriad" typically stands alone without "the." The phrase is awkward and less natural.
 
• The sentence is grammatically incorrect due to the use of "the" with "myriad."__
 
 
 
• **D. The myriad of possibilities unfolds when an artist embarks on the journey of creative experimentation.**
 __
 
• This sentence suffers from the same issue as option C — "the myriad" is not a common or preferred usage for "myriad."
 
• This sentence is grammatically incorrect due to the use of "the" with "myriad."__
 
 
 
• __Therefore, the grammatically correct and contextually fitting option is option B.__
 
• **Thus, the correct answer is "A myriad of possibilities unfolds when an artist embarks on a journey of creative experimentation."**
